programmes.show_description: (2020) Polish drama. An unusually authentic viral video changes everything for a social media fitness influencer whose confident online persona masks her vulnerability. In Polish/subs.
(1969) Award-winning historical drama based on the life of Anne Boleyn starring Richard Burton, Genevieve Bujold, who won a Golden Globe for the role, and Anthony Quayle.
(1966) Bing Crosby and Ann-Margret star in this remake of John Ford's classic western. A group of disparate strangers are thrown together while travelling through dangerous territory.
(1967) World War II thriller. George Peppard, Rock Hudson and Nigel Green lead a daring Allied raid to destroy Nazi fuel dumps in North Africa.
(2012) Sci-fi action-adventure starring Taylor Kitsch, Liam Neeson and Rihanna. When aliens land spacecraft in the Pacific Ocean, only the US and Japanese navies can save Earth.
(1996) Blockbusting landmark sci-fi action-thriller starring Will Smith and Jeff Goldblum. A US Air Force pilot and a scientist battle aliens who are spectacularly destroying our planet.
(2022) Sci-fi fantasy with new-comer Raffiella Chapman and Eddie Marsan. A resourceful teenager scavenges to survive in a mushy and mushroom-y post-apocalyptic world of have and have-nots.
(2019) Action-comedy starring Dave Bautista as a tough cop and Kumail Nanjiani as a mild-mannered Uber driver who he hires to tail a violent drug kingpin around LA.
...Weapon: (1942) WWII spy adventure starring Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce. Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson attempt to prevent the Nazis from acquiring a revolutionary invention.
(1950) Western. James Stewart stars as sharpshooter Lin McAdam, who wins a Winchester rifle. But a murderous rival steals his prize, so McAdam sets out on an epic journey in pursuit.
(1948) Billy Wilder's film stars Jean Arthur and Marlene Dietrich as the chalk-and-cheese women in post-war Berlin with John Lund as the man caught between them.
(1954) Swashbuckling adventure. One of King Arthur's courtiers, the Viking Prince Valiant (Robert Wagner) uncovers the evil Sir Brack's (James Mason) plot to kill the king. Can he foil him?
(1965) Second World War adventure. Frank Sinatra stars as the leader of Allied prisoners of war attempting to slip the clutches of their Italian captors. Co-starring Trevor Howard.
(2022) A gang of violent home-invaders find out the hard way that you REALLY don't want to be on Santa's naughty list, in Tommy Wirkola's dark, violent Christmas comedy. With David Harbour.
(2017) Fantasy adventure starring Matt Damon and Willem Dafoe. In 11th-century China, Europeans seeking the secret of gunpowder are caught up in a war against alien monsters.
